{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
invalid_count = sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Check if any revenue values were invalid
invalid_rows = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isna()]

invalid_count, invalid_rows.head()"}
